title: Structural and functional analysis of the accessory gene regulators of Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus epidermidis: an in Silico approach.
authors: Dey, Subhamoy; Manna, Tuhin; Guchhait, Kartik Chandra; Karmakar, Monalisha; Jana, Debarati; Raul, Priyanka; Ballav, Saroj; Manna, Mousumi; Hazra, Subrata; Panda, Amiya Kumar; Ghosh, Chandradipa
one_liner_zh: 该研究用AlphaFold/TrRosetta和分子对接分析金黄色葡萄球菌与表皮葡萄球菌Agr蛋白结构及蛋白-蛋白互作，但对象为细菌蛋白-蛋白体系，非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus epidermidis are tenacious pathogens that cause toxic shock syndrome. Accessory gene regulator (Agr) of Staphylococcus sp. controls the expression of multiple genes that encode virulence properties. Evolutionary covariance of accessory gene regulators of selected strains of two Staphylococcus sp. was entrenched through multiple sequence alignment, relative synonymous codon usage, codon adaptation index and compositional analysis. Artificial intelligence and machine learning based AlphaFold and TrRosetta were used to determine the tertiary structures of the proteins. Structure-based ab initio models could forecast subcellular localization, domain length, molecular docking, and simulation of Agrs in the isolates belonging to Staphylococcus sp. RESULTS: AT ending codons are preferred over GC ending codons. Besides, the mutational pressure has been found to be one of the causative factors in shaping the codon usage biasness. Topological investigations reveal the existence of AgrA and AgrD in the cytosol, while AgrB and AgrC to reside in the cellular membrane. All Agrs are acidic and stable, except AgrB. Secondary structural studies showed that Agrs mostly consist of alpha-helix followed by random coils that preferentially remain in the transmembrane region. Protein-protein docking studies using the HDOCK server demonstrated that AgrA has stronger binding affinity with AgrC in S. epidermidis isolates than the same in S. aureus. By analysing the docking potential of AgrB and AgrD, it has been found that S. aureus possesses higher docking score than S. epidermidis. CONCLUSION: Such compressive investigations could provide crucial insights into the structural features of Agrs in S. aureus and S. epidermidis, that are actively implicated in quorum sensing signalling-mediated virulence factor regulation and help in the identification of new Agr-dependent quorum sensing inhibitors. AgrA and AgrC are, therefore, appear to be seemingly promising in the management of bacterial infections and are apprehended to be useful therapeutic targets for the discovery of potential antimicrobial drugs.
abstract_zh: 背景：金黄色葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）和表皮葡萄球菌（Staphylococcus epidermidis）是引起中毒性休克综合征的顽固病原体。葡萄球菌属（Staphylococcus sp.）的附属基因调节子（Accessory gene regulator, Agr）控制着多个编码毒力特性的基因表达。通过多序列比对、相对同义密码子使用、密码子适应指数和组成分析，确立了所选两株葡萄球菌属菌株的附属基因调节子的进化协变性。基于人工智能和机器学习的AlphaFold和TrRosetta被用于确定蛋白质的三级结构。基于结构的从头模型可预测葡萄球菌属分离株中Agrs的亚细胞定位、结构域长度、分子对接和模拟。结果：AT结尾密码子优于GC结尾密码子。此外，突变压力被发现是塑造密码子使用偏倚的致病因素之一。拓扑学研究表明，AgrA和AgrD存在于细胞质中，而AgrB和AgrC位于细胞膜上。除AgrB外，所有Agrs均为酸性且稳定。二级结构研究表明，Agrs主要由α-螺旋组成，其次是随机卷曲，这些结构优先保留在跨膜区域。使用HDOCK服务器进行的蛋白质-蛋白质对接研究表明，在表皮葡萄球菌分离株中，AgrA与AgrC的结合亲和力强于金黄色葡萄球菌中的相应结合。通过分析AgrB和AgrD的对接潜力，发现金黄色葡萄球菌的对接分数高于表皮葡萄球菌。结论：此类综合性研究可为金黄色葡萄球菌和表皮葡萄球菌中Agrs的结构特征提供关键见解，这些特征积极参与群体感应信号介导的毒力因子调控，并有助于识别新的Agr依赖性群体感应抑制剂。因此，AgrA和AgrC在细菌感染管理中似乎具有前景，并被预期成为发现潜在抗菌药物的有用治疗靶点。
